service_cycles.semantics: Sum of modeled stage service work; stages may overlap. Not elapsed time or a sum of resource busy cycles.

elapsed_cycles.semantics: Disjoint elapsed-time partition; available stages sum to timing.total_cycles. No overlap is charged twice.

lifetime_validation.policy: Preallocated K/V and new-token inputs remain resident; state outputs alias the cache; transfer buffer is reused.

schedule.policy: Append new K/V only, then stream filled cache once per KV head; one reusable transfer buffer, no full read copy.

clock_hz.conditions: Reference clock; not an effective instruction rate.

tensorcores_per_chip.conditions: Architectural inventory; the counter uses one TensorCore.

mxus_per_tensorcore.conditions: Physical inventory and maximum parallel MXUs per logical output block. The execution policy chooses block sizes; unused MXUs remain idle.

mxu_rows.conditions: Physical matrix geometry, not a logical-block alignment rule.

mxu_columns.conditions: Physical matrix geometry, not a logical-block alignment rule.

int8_macs_per_cell_cycle.conditions: Assumed ideal active-cell INT8 MAC rate, used for specification peaks and analytical MXU compute service; not calibrated instruction throughput.

vector_base_ops_per_cycle.version: TPU hardware schema 3, 2026-11-17; not hardware calibration
vector_base_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Fixed reference assumption: 1 VPU * 128 lanes * 16 ALUs/lane, assuming each ALU supplies one equivalent basic operation/cycle. Geometry does not establish operation-specific throughput. One shared service per TensorCore; dtype rates are alternatives, not independent parallel resources. Not used by current GEMM. No runtime geometry fallback; update the value explicitly when changing its basis.

vector_int32_add_cost.version: TPU hardware schema 3, 2026-11-17; not hardware calibration
vector_int32_add_cost.conditions: One scalar-element INT32 addition costs one equivalent operation on the shared Vector service. Logical modeling assumption, not verified instruction throughput. No extra Vector charge for current MXU accumulation.

vector_fp32_basic_op_cost.version: TPU Vector/Nonlinear algorithmic reference v1, 2026-11-18; not hardware calibration
vector_fp32_basic_op_cost.conditions: One scalar-element FP32 ADD or MUL costs one equivalent operation on the shared Vector service. EXP and RSQRT have separately configured total equivalent-work costs. FMA, DIV, conversions, reductions and full nonlinear operators have no implicit cost. Not used by current GEMM.

vector_fp32_exp_cost.source: Project algorithmic work proxy; ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-vector-service; method shared with ARCHITECTURE.md#tsp-vxm-service
vector_fp32_exp_cost.version: TPU Vector/Nonlinear algorithmic reference v1, 2026-11-18; not hardware calibration
vector_fp32_exp_cost.conditions: FP32 approximation work proxy: k=round(x*log2(e)), r=x-k*ln(2) costs 4; degree-5 Taylor polynomial in Horner form costs 5 MUL + 5 ADD; exponent scaling costs 1, total 15. Round and exponent scaling each count as one equivalent operation. No fused-operation discount. Reference domain is finite x in [-80,0]; no correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate exp numerically, and is not native TPU Exp instruction throughput or latency. Shares the per-TensorCore Vector budget; memory and dependencies are separate. Fixed total equivalent-work cost, independent of vector_fp32_basic_op_cost. Adopts the project TSP algorithmic counting convention, not TSP throughput. Not used by current GEMM.

vector_fp32_rsqrt_cost.source: Project algorithmic work proxy; ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-vector-service; method shared with ARCHITECTURE.md#tsp-vxm-service
vector_fp32_rsqrt_cost.version: TPU Vector/Nonlinear algorithmic reference v1, 2026-11-18; not hardware calibration
vector_fp32_rsqrt_cost.conditions: Positive-normal FP32 approximation work proxy: bit seed bits(y)=0x5f3759df-(bits(x)>>1) costs 2 (shift and subtraction; bit reinterpretation costs 0), then two iterations y=(0.5*y)*(3-x*y*y), each 4 MUL + 1 SUB, total 12. No fused-operation discount. No correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate rsqrt numerically, and is not native TPU RSqrt instruction throughput or latency. Shares the per-TensorCore Vector budget; memory and dependencies are separate. Fixed total equivalent-work cost, independent of vector_fp32_basic_op_cost. Adopts the project TSP algorithmic counting convention, not TSP throughput. Not used by current GEMM.

vmem_usable_bytes.conditions: Logical scenario allows the full reference VMEM for A/B/C; runtime reservations, packing and spills are not modeled. Not a measured allocatable capacity.

vmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.source: ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-parameters: parameter gaps in the cited TPU v4 paper and product documentation
vmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.version: TPU count model v1, 2026-11-15; model assumption made explicit in configuration 2026-11-16
vmem_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Method: 4 MXUs * (128 rows + 128 columns) INT8 bytes/cycle * 1.05e9 Hz = 1075200000000 B/s. Assume shared read/write service; runtime divides by clock_hz. Explicit analytical assumption, not measured hardware calibration. Fixed configuration value; update it explicitly when changing its hardware basis.

cmem_physical_bytes.source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.01433 (PDF p2, section 2 opening paragraphs; PDF p7, Table 4)
cmem_physical_bytes.conditions: Shared scratchpad counted once per chip, not a transparent cache.

cmem_usable_bytes.version: TPU hardware schema 3, 2026-11-17; not hardware calibration
cmem_usable_bytes.conditions: Assume all 128 MiB physical CMEM is usable. Single-TensorCore tiled execution gets floor(chip usable bytes / tensorcores_per_chip), with no idle-share borrowing. One or two capacity-checked cold slots hold full-K INT8 A/B panels; C remains in VMEM. This is an allocation scenario, not measured runtime capacity. Bypass allocates no CMEM.

cmem_read_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.source: https://pypi.org/project/libtpu/0.0.40/ (Pufferfish SharedMemory[CMEM].parts.bytes_per_second; verified binary decode); https://markgottscho.com/cv/papers/2021_NJouppi_ISCA.pdf (PDF p10, read/write ratio only); ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-cmem-proxy
cmem_read_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.version: libtpu 0.0.40 cp314 Linux x86_64, published 2026-04-14; verified 2026-11-18; CMEM directional proxy v2
cmem_read_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Method: read = 2150704873472 B/s. The libtpu 0.0.40 Pufferfish standard and lite SharedMemory[CMEM].parts.bytes_per_second field is 2150704873472 B/s (2003 GiB/s), identical in both variants. The field does not distinguish read and write; assigning it to the chip read service and applying the TPUv4i 2000:1000 read/write ratio are explicit model assumptions, not validated TPU v4 directional bandwidth or silicon calibration. Decimal byte/s in this configuration; preserve the decoded integer without implying measurement precision. Independent read/write directions; do not multiply by TensorCore count or sum directions. Tiled execution divides each direction equally among TensorCores with no idle borrowing. HBM-to-CMEM fill and CMEM-to-VMEM read each reserve both endpoints at their minimum bandwidth. Capacity-checked CMEM slots permit outer-fill/inner-execution overlap under resource_pipeline. Different live slots may read and write concurrently. Fills and output exports share the same HBM service; slot reuse waits for its last read. Serial mode disables overlap. No additional OCI/bank/port bottleneck beyond these effective services. Bypass consumes neither direction.

cmem_write_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.source: https://pypi.org/project/libtpu/0.0.40/ (Pufferfish SharedMemory[CMEM].parts.bytes_per_second; verified binary decode); https://markgottscho.com/cv/papers/2021_NJouppi_ISCA.pdf (PDF p10, read/write ratio only); ARCHITECTURE.md#tpu-cmem-proxy
cmem_write_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.version: libtpu 0.0.40 cp314 Linux x86_64, published 2026-04-14; verified 2026-11-18; CMEM directional proxy v2
cmem_write_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Method: write = 2150704873472 * (1000 / 2000) = 1075352436736 B/s. This is not a separately decoded write-bandwidth field. The libtpu 0.0.40 Pufferfish standard and lite SharedMemory[CMEM].parts.bytes_per_second field is 2150704873472 B/s (2003 GiB/s), identical in both variants. The field does not distinguish read and write; assigning it to the chip read service and applying the TPUv4i 2000:1000 read/write ratio are explicit model assumptions, not validated TPU v4 directional bandwidth or silicon calibration. Decimal byte/s in this configuration; preserve the decoded integer without implying measurement precision. Independent read/write directions; do not multiply by TensorCore count or sum directions. Tiled execution divides each direction equally among TensorCores with no idle borrowing. HBM-to-CMEM fill and CMEM-to-VMEM read each reserve both endpoints at their minimum bandwidth. Capacity-checked CMEM slots permit outer-fill/inner-execution overlap under resource_pipeline. Different live slots may read and write concurrently. Fills and output exports share the same HBM service; slot reuse waits for its last read. Serial mode disables overlap. No additional OCI/bank/port bottleneck beyond these effective services. Bypass consumes neither direction.

hbm_physical_bytes.conditions: Unified physical HBM2 capacity; 32 GiB, not 32 decimal GB.

hbm_usable_bytes.conditions: Logical scenario allocates up to physical HBM; real runtime reserves memory. A/B/C coexist, no host offload. Not a measured runtime limit.

hbm_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Published aggregate bandwidth, decimal GB/s; no inference of single-TensorCore effective bandwidth.

limitations: Cache offsets and head layouts are symbolic; no gather/scatter or transpose instructions.
Resident copy counts MEM-to-stream and stream-to-MEM service; transient forwarding registers are not modeled.
Reads end in a reusable local tile buffer or stream; no second full cache allocation.

cache_state.semantics: Immutable length/version descriptors over the same preallocated backing buffers; no numerical cache values are stored.

attention_execution_profile.conditions: Single-token Decode with uniform cache lengths. INT8 what-if storage, FP32 scale/Softmax. Preallocated per-KV-head backing is shared; each query head rereads K/V using native GEMM, with no physical repeat or transpose instruction. Q/K/V projection, position processing, output projection, cache eviction and chip execution are outside this block.

ascend.conditions: HBM 与 UB 同时预约的 DMA 取两端最小服务率。输入 DMA、UB 操作数读取、计算、UB 结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行，L2 bypass。每次算子调用为冷启动。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tpu.conditions: HBM 按 TensorCore 数均分，VMEM 为单核共享服务。输入 DMA、操作数读取、计算、结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行；CMEM bypass。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tsp.conditions: 完整输入和输出驻留所选本侧 MEM。每个输入读取受 MEM 和输入 stream 共同约束；输出写回受 MEM 和输出 stream 共同约束。FP32/INT32 每元素 4 byte，stream 每块按完整宽度补齐，MEM 只计逻辑载荷。使用一个共享 VXM 任务预算，CIM 不复制预算。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

ascend_ub_read_bpc.conditions: 每周期 64 个 32-bit 字作为独立 UB 端口服务代理：64*4=256 B/cycle。参考现有 Vector 预算量级选择，不是实测 UB 带宽；数值固定，不随 compute budget 修改。读写分阶段串行，DMA 同时预约 HBM 和 UB。

ascend_ub_write_bpc.conditions: 每周期 64 个 32-bit 字作为独立 UB 端口服务代理：64*4=256 B/cycle。参考现有 Vector 预算量级选择，不是实测 UB 带宽；数值固定，不随 compute budget 修改。读写分阶段串行，DMA 同时预约 HBM 和 UB。

composite.conditions: Last-axis FP32. Serial rows, passes and tiles. Balanced binary reduction levels wait for predecessors; partials merge into one row state. Constants are implicit; one scalar read per tile broadcasts without extra shuffle work. RMSNorm rereads x and loads weight per row. Softmax stores exp in the output allocation, then normalizes it. No numerical accuracy or hardware-instruction claims.

fp32_sub_cost.conditions: One scalar SUB modeled as one basic equivalent operation; shares native Vector/VXM budget, not calibrated.

fp32_max_cost.conditions: One pairwise MAX comparison/selection modeled as one equivalent operation; not calibrated.

fp32_rcp_cost.conditions: Algorithmic proxy: one seed-equivalent operation plus two Newton-style updates of two MUL and one SUB each: 1+2*3=7. Seed accuracy and numerical result are not modeled; not native reciprocal timing.

reduction_round_cycles.conditions: Minimum compute dependency interval per tree level or cross-tile binary merge. Total compute is max(weighted-work cycles, this value); memory and startup charged separately. Not a measured shuffle or lane-network latency.

io_contract.name_scope: Within one operator call; graph callers must qualify names by node identity.
io_contract.intermediate_residency: No UB/VMEM/register retention across operator calls is promised.
io_contract.conversion: No implicit cast, dequantization or requantization; stored dtype is binding.
io_contract.traffic: Standalone actions already include each block's boundary accesses; connections do not remove them.
